summary: Structured Obligations Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K reporting a scheduled distribution to holders of Select Notes Trust LT 2003-1 Certificates on the September 15, 2026 Interest Distribution Date. The trustee, U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, reported interest received by the Trust of $315,625.00 for the interest period from August 16 through September 15, 2026, with each holder's pro rata share reportable on Form 1099. The filing satisfies ongoing Exchange Act reporting for the trust and notes underlying issuers representing 10% or more of the trust file periodic reports; no special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms are present.
